|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 1 of 4 known; the September 2009 first printing is lost). The image here, the Players Committee card image, prints it. The current text is [[Captain Bewil (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-captainbewil-pre.gif]]), slip 04E, in the V-kit copy by 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-1220_4">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/blob/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips/virtual6-dark/captainbewil.png V-kit slip image virtual6-dark/captainbewil.png] (Lee Edwards' V-kit, svn r1, committed 9 December 2009; copy on GitHub). It is the same image as the Players Committee card image.</ref>: “Agenda: logistics. While at Conference Room, opponent must lose 3 Force to 'react' away from a battle, and, if your total Influence here is > 3, during your turn you may take an Interrupt into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.” This is the 9 September 2009 errata (ruling H1, Bill, 10 November 2026); the card list later stamps this wording "(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)". The image is dated by the V-kit copy, not by its later server upload (25 February 2013). The September 2009 first printing is lost, so it has no page. '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “04E” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 2 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Bewil (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): Virtual Block 2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 04E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; surviving copy built 18 December 2009), page 2, slip 04E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Agenda: logistics. While at Conference Room, opponent must lose 3 Force to 'react' away from a battle, and, if your total influence here is > 3, during your turn you may take an Interrupt into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-04E-Captain_Bewil.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; slip number “04E” bottom right, the Virtual Block 2 set mark. '''What changed:''' “total Influence” is written “total influence”, with a small i.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Captain Bewil (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 2 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1220_4">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock2Type (Virtual Block 2 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Agenda: logistics. While at Conference Room, opponent must lose 3 Force to 'react' away from a battle, and, if your total Influence here is > 3, during your turn you may take an Interrupt into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “total influence” is written “total Influence” again, with a capital I: the same words as PC-E1. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). No published image shows the card-list text, so the image of [[Captain Bewil (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] is a CardMaker recreation. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.

It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat).
